about: API rates for `telemetry.py cost`, an API-equivalent estimate: never a subscription's spend. Prices per million tokens, from the provider's published pricing, each with the date it applies from and its source. Entry shape: {"provider": "anthropic", "model": "<model id as recorded>", "currency": "USD", "input": "<n>", "output": "<n>", "cache_read": "<n>", "cache_write": "<n>", "effective_from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "source": "<url>"}. cache_write is one combined rate: the transcripts give 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes as one figure, so that sum is valued at this rate (the 5-minute rate undervalues 1-hour writes, the 1-hour rate overvalues 5-minute ones). Empty: no price is assumed.
